description: Roll out a RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipeline for a customer support chatbot. Must: ingest documentation (5000 pages) into a vector store, chunk documents with overlap (512 tokens, 64 overlap), generate embeddings and index them, configure retrieval (top-k=5, similarity threshold), implement generation with GPT-4o-mini, deploy evaluation pipeline (faithfulness, relevance metrics), and monitor answer quality. Risk factors: chunking strategy missing context, retrieval returning irrelevant chunks, hallucination in generation, eval metrics not catching bad answers. Tools available: LangChain, OpenAI API, Qdrant, Python, Kubernetes.
